sequential_dependency.intermediate: An input-dependent ordered color/count vector, excluding unlisted objects and the legend markers themselves.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Locate the black legend board, exclude it, and count eight-connected monochrome objects of each listed color; then rank those colors by increasing count.
sequential_dependency.step_b: At successive board rows, paint each ranked color once per cumulative prefix total, not merely its own object count.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: B needs both the recovered component counts and their count-dependent rank. Changing connectivity or using the original legend order changes the cumulative totals and the color assigned to their rows.
